info.title: QenBel Administration tool gateway
info.description: Tools an AI agent can call for one business. Sample generated from @qenbel/tool-registry. Replace the server URL with your own deployment.

tags.name: Tools
tags.description: Narrow, permissioned actions for AI agents. Each call is validated and audited on the server.

post.description: Returns the business's name, locations, opening hours, contact details, cancellation policy, how it takes bookings and orders, and which details a customer must give to book or order. Call it first in a conversation and whenever the customer asks about hours, address or policy. Does not return prices, staff lists, availability, customer records or anything about a particular booking or order.

post.description: Finds an existing customer by phone number, email or name and returns only their id, first name and masked contact details. Use it to link a booking or order to a returning customer. Give at least one of phone, email or name; phone or email are exact matches, name is a partial match. On WhatsApp and API calls the server limits results to the contact in the conversation. Does not create or change customers, does not return full phone numbers, email addresses, notes, visit history or payment details, and cannot list all customers.

post.description: Lists what the business offers (services, products or menu items) with name, short description, price in paise, duration and whether it can be booked or ordered now. Use it to answer what is offered and to find the item id needed by check_availability and create_order_draft. Filter by a search word or category. Results are paged. Does not check availability or stock for a date, does not apply discounts, and never returns items the business has hidden or archived.

post.description: Returns free times for one service (or a table for a party size) between two dates, in the business's local time. Always call it before offering a time; never guess times. Pass the service id from get_catalogue when the business books by service, and partySize when it books tables. You may name a preferred staff member or location. Does not reserve anything: a time can be taken by someone else before you hold it, so follow with create_booking_hold. It does not return prices and does not look further than 14 days from the start date.

post.description: Holds one time from check_availability for a short while so nobody else can take it, and returns a booking in HOLD status with an expiry. Use it once the customer has picked a time, then collect their details and call confirm_booking before the hold expires. Pass the same start time and resource that check_availability returned. Does not confirm the booking and does not tell the customer it is booked. A hold that is not confirmed in time is released on its own. It does not take payment.

post.description: Turns a live hold into a confirmed booking once you have the customer's details. Pass the booking id from create_booking_hold, the customer's name and contact details, and answers to any extra questions listed in the business profile. Only say the booking is confirmed after this call succeeds. Does not work on a hold that has expired or on a booking that is already confirmed, cancelled or completed, does not change the time (use reschedule_booking), and does not take payment.

post.description: Moves a confirmed booking to a new time taken from check_availability. The old time is released only if the new one is free. Use it when the customer asks to change the time of an existing booking. Pass expectedVersion from the last read of the booking if you have it. Does not change the service, the customer or the party size, does not work on cancelled, completed or no-show bookings, and does not create a new booking.

post.description: Cancels a booking and applies the business's cancellation policy. The result says whether the cancellation was inside the free window and whether a fee applies, so you can tell the customer plainly. Use it only when the customer clearly asks to cancel. Ask them to confirm first. Does not refund money, does not rebook, does not work on bookings that are already cancelled, completed or marked no-show, and cannot override the policy: if the business does not allow online cancellation it returns an error, so offer escalate_to_human.

200.description: The tool ran. The body is the tool's output.

post.description: Creates an order in DRAFT status from catalogue items and quantities, and returns the priced lines and total so the customer can check them. Use it once the customer has said what they want. Read the lines and total back to them, then call confirm_order if they agree. Use item ids from get_catalogue. Does not place the order, does not take payment, does not accept discounts or prices from the customer, and does not reserve stock. If an item is not available it returns an error that names it.

post.description: Places a draft order (DRAFT to PLACED) once the customer has agreed to the lines and total and you have their details. Pass the order id from create_order_draft and the customer's name and contact details. Only say the order is placed after this call succeeds. Does not take payment, does not change items or quantities (make a new draft for that), does not work on orders that are already placed, cancelled or fulfilled, and does not promise a ready or delivery time.

post.description: Creates a follow-up task for the business's staff and flags the conversation so a person takes over. Use it when the customer asks for a person, is upset, has a medical or urgent problem, wants something no other tool can do, or a tool keeps failing. Write a short summary a staff member can act on without reading the chat. Does not solve the problem, does not contact the customer by itself, and does not promise when someone will reply. Tell the customer that the business has been told.

value.summary: Asha wants to talk to the owner about a group booking for 12 people on 20 December.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique per intended action. Repeating a call with the same key and body returns the first result for 24 hours. The same key with a different body is an error.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed in the current window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before trying again.

IdempotentReplayed.description: `true` when this response is the stored result of an earlier call with the same Idempotency-Key.
